messages.chains: run the four C-call chains (pcall, resume, __index through table.concat, __tostring through string.format) to the limit
messages.json: the same chains, with json.encode of a 16-deep table and json.decode of a 16-deep array at the bottom of each
messages.floats: json round trips of 0.1, 5e-324, 1e+100, -9.9999999999999995e-08 and 9007199254740993: the host's text, and whether the text reads back
messages.floats_exact: 1000 floats of 17 digits through encode and decode: how many come back as the same double
messages.floats_time: {n, decode}: n encodes (or decodes) of an array of 1000 floats
messages.widgets: 128 widgets of every kind, boxes 4 deep, handlers, a 256-byte text; returns where to tap the deepest
messages.hits: the events the handlers have seen
